pill.desc: white capsule with a colored band, band color varies by strength

clues.kinetics: Absolute bioavailability has not been studied, and food increases total absorption by 10% to 20%. Protein binding is about 97%, and the drug is mainly cleared by CYP2C9 metabolism.
clues.substance: Molecular weight 381.4, and it is practically insoluble in aqueous media at physiological pH.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA in strengths from 50 mg to 400 mg; doses up to 200 mg are given twice daily.
clues.safety: Boxed warning on serious cardiovascular and gastrointestinal events. Contraindicated around bypass graft surgery and with sulfonamide allergy; dyspepsia and abdominal pain are common reasons for stopping.
clues.indication: Relief of osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, juvenile rheumatoid arthritis from age 2, ankylosing spondylitis, acute pain in adults and primary dysmenorrhea.
clues.mechanism: It is believed to work by inhibiting prostaglandin synthesis, primarily through inhibition of the enzyme COX-2.

tell: A high fat meal delays this COX-2 inhibitor's peak by 1 to 2 hours while raising total absorption 10% to 20%.
